title: Minhaj al-Talibin
author: al-nawawi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Nawawi's abridgement of al-Rafi'i's al-Muharrar, stating the preferred Shafi'i ruling on each question and marking where he corrects his source. It became the definitive text of the later Shafi'i school, on which the standard commentaries of Ibn Hajar al-Haytami and al-Ramli were written.
historicalContext: Written in Damascus near the end of al-Nawawi's life, the Minhaj was the basis of Shafi'i practice from Egypt to Southeast Asia. Van den Berg edited it with a French translation in 1882, and E. C. Howard's English version of that translation (1914) is the edition the acquisition register still seeks in a clean transcription.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
